text:
Tom Emmer posts on immigration enforcement and endorses Florida congressional candidates
B. A. Foley
Tom Emmer, U.S. Congressman representing Minnesota’s 6th district since 2015, posted several statements on social media between August 31 and September 2, 2026, addressing issues of immigration enforcement and political endorsements.
On August 31, Emmer publicly thanked federal immigration officers for their work in Minnesota. He wrote: "Thank you to our federal immigration officers for taking dangerous illegal aliens off Minnesota’s streets. Assault. Sexual assault. Theft. Burglary. These aren’t neighbors, they’re criminals who never should have been here. This is how we Make Minnesota Safe Again."
Two days later, on September 2, Emmer announced his support for congressional candidates in Florida. In one post he stated, "Proud to announce my endorsement of an America First Patriot, @DanGreenFL! Dan will be a great Congressman for #FL09!" In another message posted the same day, he added, "Proud to announce my endorsement of a MAGA warrior and the next congressman for #FL14, @MBeltranFL! We’re looking forward to welcoming Mike to the House Republican Team in November."
Emmer has served as a member of Congress since replacing Michele Bachmann in 2015 and previously was a member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2005 to 2011. Born in South Bend, Indiana in 1961 and currently residing in Delano at age 62, Emmer holds degrees from the University of Alaska-Fairbanks (BA) and William Mitchell College of Law (JD).
